summary.en: Biocon's development centers on biosimilars and complex peptide generics, including Biocon Biologics' next oncology wave. Pertuzumab gained US approval in November 2026, leaving newer oncology candidates with less detailed public staging.
summary.zh: Biocon 的开发以生物类似药和复杂多肽仿制药为核心,包括 Biocon Biologics 的下一波肿瘤产品。Pertuzumab 于 2026 年 11 月获美国批准,较新的肿瘤候选药物公开披露的阶段信息较少。

watch.en: FDA approved Pebrilzo, the pertuzumab biosimilar, on November 16, 2026.
watch.zh: FDA 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日批准 pertuzumab 生物类似药 Pebrilzo。

watch.en: Quarterly interest costs fell 12% year on year to INR240 crore in Q2 FY27.
watch.zh: 2027 财年第二季度利息支出同比下降 12%,至 INR240 crore。

watch.en: Biosimilars revenue of INR2,809 crore exceeded generics revenue of INR774 crore in Q2 FY27.
watch.zh: 2027 财年第二季度生物类似药收入 INR2,809 crore,超过仿制药收入 INR774 crore。
